verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents a fullscreen dashboard giving an overview of every session, showing which agents need input, which are working, and which are done. Worktree sessions isolate parallel agents so they cannot overwrite each other's files, and /resume, /fork, background subagents and child sessions support juggling multiple agent-driven workstreams from the TUI. Missing for 10: detail on interacting with or switching between sessions from the dashboard itself, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-session management.
